description: Computes the street network reachable from a point within a time budget, for walk, stroller, wheelchair or bike profiles (steps and rough surfaces slow or block the middle two; cycle paths are bike-only). Returns a summary with total street length, extent, and a map link. Currently covers Berlin, Germany.

include_geometry.description: Also return the raw GeoJSON (10 arrival-time bands, large)

include_places.description: Also summarise how many places of each group are reachable (food, shops, culture, health, learning, outdoors, money)

minutes.description: Time budget in minutes. Faster profiles allow fewer: walking allows up to 25, cycling up to 10, because the work grows with the area searched. Omit to use the profile's sensible default.

target.description: Optional destination: reports whether it's reachable in the time budget and the approximate arrival time

name: reachable_area
title: Reachable area on foot or by bike
